hooks.description: Remove stale kelo cache versions, keep only the active one
Detect commit intent and force kelo:commit skill invocation

Guard destructive git commands: back up then allow (reset --hard, checkout --, restore, clean -f, stash drop/clear, branch -D, update-ref -d); block only force push/delete on protected branches, push --mirror, filter-repo, reflog delete/expire
Block shell writes to kelo-managed lint config files (eslint.config.mjs, stylelint.config.mjs, analysis_options.yaml with a kelo header; .kelo/plugins/**)
Block edits to kelo-managed lint config files (eslint.config.mjs, stylelint.config.mjs, analysis_options.yaml with a kelo header; .kelo/plugins/**)
